{{Quote|Siphon reed. Keep going or it will get you, too.|Abeloth to Khai, after Rhea was pulled underwater by a siphon reed|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>}}
A '''siphon reed''' was a type of reed that lived in [[Water/Legends|water]] on a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], when a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|Sith strike team]] arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in search of [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], the team's leader [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]] was dragged into a whirlpool by a siphon reed while crossing a river. Her [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Vestara Khai]], attempted to save her, only to be pulled into the whirlpool herself. Khai managed to find and free Rhea from reeds pulling her deeper and deeper into water then Rhea [[Telekinesis/Legends|thrust]] both of them out of the water, where they were caught, held stable, and helped back to shore by the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] apprentice [[Ahri Raas]]. After this incident, Khai was able to see the true nature of [[Abeloth]]&mdash;a being powerful in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] who had the ability to control all the [[Plant/Legends|plant]] life on the world&mdash;as she realized that Abeloth had to have caused the reed to attack Rhea.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Abyss" />
